multi.content: What is lightning?
Lightning is a giant spark of electricity between clouds and the ground during a storm.
Can I outrun it?
Tell me about Mount Everest.
Mount Everest is the highest mountain on Earth, on the border of Nepal and China.
Could I climb it without any training?
What do bees eat?
Bees eat nectar and pollen that they collect from flowers.
Can I keep bees in my garden?
Hi, I'm Sara and I love painting.
Nice to meet you, Sara! Painting is a wonderful hobby. How can I help?
What hobby did I say I love?
Suggest a pet for a small apartment.
A goldfish is a quiet, low-maintenance pet for a small apartment.
I don't like fish. Something else?
What's 9 plus 6?
9 plus 6 is 15.
Now subtract 5.
What's the capital of Japan?
The capital of Japan is Kyoto.
I think it's Tokyo.
What's the capital of Italy?
The capital of Italy is Rome.
Are you sure?
How deep is the ocean?
The deepest part of the ocean is about 11 kilometers deep.
Could I swim to the bottom?
Give me a simple soup recipe.
Simmer chopped carrots, onion and potato in broth for 20 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
I don't have carrots. What can I use instead?
Tell me a fun fact.
Honey never spoils. Jars found in ancient tombs were still edible.
Another one, please.
How do magnets work?
Magnets pull on metals like iron because of the way their tiny particles line up.
Can I use one to pick up a wooden spoon?
I have a test tomorrow and I'm tired.
That's tough. A short review and a good night's sleep usually help more than cramming.
Should I stay up all night to study?
What is the speed of light?
Light travels about 300,000 kilometers every second.
Can I run that fast?
Recommend a sport for me.
Swimming is a great full-body sport.
I can't swim. Something else?
My name is Leo.
Nice to meet you, Leo! What can I do for you?
What's the first letter of my name?
Translate 'hello' into Spanish.
'Hello' in Spanish is 'hola'.
And 'goodbye'?
What is a volcano?
A volcano is an opening in the Earth's crust where hot melted rock, called lava, comes out.
Can I stand in lava?
Give me a workout tip.
Warm up for five minutes before you start to avoid injury.
I only have ten minutes. What can I do?
What is the Sahara?
The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world, in northern Africa.
Could I cross it on foot without water?
